```python
import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd

# Create sample DataFrame
data = {
    "id": [1, 2, 3],
    "jan": [100, 200, 300],
    "feb": [150, 250, 350],
    "mar": [175, 275, 375]
}
pandas_df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Convert to narwhals DataFrame
df = nw.from_native(pandas_df)

# Reshape from wide to long format
result = df.unpivot(
    index="id",
    on=["jan", "feb", "mar"],
    variable_name="month",
    value_name="sales"
)

# Display result
print(nw.to_native(result))
```
